integrity: Analytical proof plus executable exact finite verification; no claim of independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: The cycle-rank process here uses all negative simple cycles, unlike the cited triangle-only rule on complete hosts.
Graph blocks are internally disjoint path bundles; arbitrary sparse graphs and weighted cycle ranks are excluded.
A historical 1978 paper on minimum balancing processes was only available in abstract, leaving a bounded priority risk.
The exact tie law concerns common path-sign products, not unique edge-level balanced signings.
title: Cycle-rank best-edge balancing is geodesic on networks of parallel-path blocks
